info.name: School ERP - AcademicService (Module 06)
info.description: Module 06 Academics, Timetable & LMS (academicservice, port 8087, /academicservice/api/v1/lms). Run the folders in order after loading module06_academic_seed.sql: sign in, then each story chains its ids into the next (quiz → attempt, homework → evaluation …). Uses the seeded DPS North accounts (Password@123). The PDF upload in US-06005 needs a local mughal-notes.pdf.
